Name: TRUE True Perfection
Author: SirPipocado
Description:
[center][size=6][b]True True Perfection[/b][/size]
[i]100% was just the beginning.[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]What is this?[/b][/size]

So you hit 100% Perfection, watched the Summit scene, and the credits rolled. Feels like the end, right?

Not anymore. This mod pushes Perfection all the way to [b]200%[/b]. The first 100% is still the regular game. The other 100% is for the people who look at the collection tab and think "but I haven't shipped a gold quality Bok Choy yet".

Every item, every quality, every fish, every outfit, every hat. And when you reach 100%, whoever is waiting for you at the Summit has a little something to say about it...

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and drop the [b]TrueTruePerfection[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and press [b]F7[/b].[/*]
[/list]
Want to remove it? Just delete the folder. Your save will be fine.

[line]

[size=5][b]The extra 100%[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Shipping (40%)[/b]: ship everything the shipping bin accepts, in every quality that item can actually have. That includes every flavor too, so yes, Blueberry Wine and Strawberry Wine are two different goals. Wine, juice, jelly, pickles, honey, roe, aged roe, smoked fish, dried fruit and dried mushrooms all count.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing (20%)[/b]: every fish in every quality. Crab pot catches only go up to silver (Deluxe Bait), and the legendaries plus Mr. Qi's legendary family just need to be caught once.[/*]
[*][b]Tailoring (12%)[/b]: every outfit the sewing machine can make. Dye colors don't count as different pieces.[/*]
[*][b]Hats (10%)[/b]: every hat you can get.[/*]
[*][b]Equipment (12%)[/b]: every weapon, ring, boot and trinket.[/*]
[*][b]Animals (6%)[/b]: every species and variety, from the humble white chicken to dinosaurs and ostriches.[/*]
[/list]
Nothing impossible is required. Items you can't get through normal play are left out, and each item only asks for the qualities it can really reach.

[line]

[size=5][b]The F7 panel[/b][/size]

Press [b]F7[/b] anywhere to open your progress. At the top there's a bar from 0 to 200%, green for the regular Perfection and gold for the extra part. Each category has its own tab, with items split into sections like minerals, artifacts, cooking, wines, rod fish and weapons, so the list doesn't turn into a wall of icons. The little stars under each item show which qualities you've already done, and there's a "Missing only" filter for when you just want to see what's left.

[b]Click any item[/b] and you'll get a small card telling you how to get it: which shop sells it and for how much, the recipe and how to unlock it, where and when to fish it (season, time and weather), which machine makes it, which monsters drop it, and a short summary from the Stardew Valley Wiki in your game's language.

[line]

[size=5][b]New Summit scenes[/b][/size]

[spoiler]
[b]At 100%:[/b] the original Summit scene gets a new ending. Whoever is up there with you mentions that your work in the valley isn't really done yet.

[b]At 200%:[/b] go back up the mountain. The whole town is waiting for you, together with the mayor and your spouse, who has a line of their own. After that, the game's original credits finally roll.[/spoiler]

[line]

[size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Older saves:[/b] the mod picks up what the game already tracks, like shipped items, caught fish, tailored clothes, the hats and gear you own and your animals. Qualities and flavors aren't stored by the game, so those start from zero.[/*]
[*][b]Other mods:[/b] only vanilla items count toward the 200%. There's no reliable way to know which modded items can actually be obtained, so they're left out.[/*]
[*][b]Save safety:[/b] your progress lives in a separate part of the save that the game itself ignores. The mod doesn't touch your items, money, friendships or your regular Perfection, and you can add or remove it whenever you want.[/*]
[*][b]Languages:[/b] English and Portuguese.[/*]
[*][b]Notifications:[/b] a little message pops up whenever you complete a new goal.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Shortcuts[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]F7[/b]: opens the progress panel.[/*]
[*][b]Ctrl + Shift + F7[/b]: instantly completes the extra 100%. Handy if you just want to see the final scene, or if you're testing things out. Keep in mind it can't be undone once you save, and the Summit still needs the regular 100% Perfection to let you in.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

In [b]config.json[/b] you can change both shortcuts, the weight of each category, turn notifications on or off, and remove specific items from the goals.

[line]

[size=5][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]In multiplayer, only the host's progress is saved for now.[/*]
[*]If you already watched the original Summit scene before installing the mod, the new 100% scene won't play (the game remembers you saw it). The 200% scene works normally.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Found something impossible?[/b][/size]

Stardew has a LOT of items, and I tried my best to leave out everything that can't actually be obtained. Still, some might have slipped through. If you find an item that's impossible to get, or a quality that item can never reach, [b]please report it in the Bugs tab as soon as you can[/b]! Tell me the item's name and what's wrong with it, and I'll fix it as fast as I can.

In the meantime, you can remove that item from your goals by adding it to [b]ExcludedItems[/b] in config.json.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[/list]

[line]

I don't have programming skills or free time, so for tedious tasks like fixing bugs in the code, filling in information and teaching me some parts of the code, GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE WAS USED. However, the original idea, in-game bug fixing, scenes, dialogue and a good part of the code were made BY ME! I hope you give the mod a chance despite that. It was made with love, and I hope you enjoy it! Thank you![/i][/size]
